request.notes: Galaxy Plotter = site page /exact-plotter (controllers/exact-plotter -> api.plotGenericRoute -> /api/generic/route). NOT /plotter (that page is the neutron router, already probed as /api/route). source/destination are system id64s, NOT names (Sol -> Lave here). There is NO manual jump-range param on this tool: range is derived server-side from the FSD fuel model (fuel_power, fuel_multiplier, optimal_mass, base_mass, tank_size, internal_tank_size, max_fuel_per_jump, range_boost) which the site computes from an imported Coriolis/SLEF ship build (objects/ship). The site also sends ship_build (raw build JSON string) but it is OPTIONAL server-side: this probe omitted it and the job completed (parameters echo shows ship_build: null). Toggle defaults shown are the site's own (use_supercharge=1, refuel_every_scoopable=1, rest 0). algorithm is one of: fuel, fuel_jumps, guided, optimistic, pessimistic (site default optimistic). max_time site default 60, UI max 120 (240 for patrons); it is consumed but NOT echoed back in parameters. Fuel-model values here approximate a 5A-FSD Asp Explorer (~35 ly laden range).
